scientific_integrity: Analytic proof supplied; exact finite checks independently recompute the finite statistics. No claim of external certification or independent review.
scientific_limitations: Bayes-optimal error is for fixed-window same-input reconstruction, iid ranks and conditionally fair independent data. Geometric asymptotics need fixed 0<q<1. No claim of universal bounds for all cellular automata, correlated data, or Ornstein bar-d optimal couplings.
title: Sharp superexponential inverse reconstruction in a countable-alphabet cellular automaton
